title: Galle Day Tour
shortDescription: A private south-coast day: turtle hatchery, Galle Dutch Fort, Bentota River boat ride, and the Tsunami Memorial.
description: A private full-day journey down Sri Lanka’s south coast: sea turtle hatchery, UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort, Bentota River mangrove boat ride, and the Tsunami Memorial, with hotel pickup included.

images.alt: Galle Fort clock tower and ramparts on a private day tour
images.title: Galle Day Tour

itinerary.title: South coast: turtles, Bentota, memorial & Galle Fort
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup and a scenic drive south. Visit a sea turtle hatchery, enjoy a Bentota River boat ride, pause at the Tsunami Memorial, then explore UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort before the evening return.
highlights: Sea turtle hatchery — conservation visit and turtle species
Bentota River boat ride — mangroves and wildlife
Galle Dutch Fort — UNESCO ramparts and ocean views

images.alt: Galle Fort clock tower and ramparts
images.title: Galle Fort lighthouse and ramparts

optionalActivities: Optional: café stop inside Galle Fort or extra time on the ramparts

faq.question: Is this a private tour?
faq.answer: Yes. All Hai Sri Lanka day tours are private for your group.

seo.metaTitle: Galle Day Tour | Private Tour from Colombo | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Book a private Galle day tour with Hai Sri Lanka. Visit Galle Fort, southern beaches, and coastal highlights with a local expert.

highlights.title: Sea turtle hatchery
highlights.description: Visit a south-coast turtle hatchery and learn about conservation work while observing different turtle species.

highlights.title: Galle Dutch Fort
highlights.description: Explore the UNESCO World Heritage fort: colonial ramparts, lighthouse lanes, and stunning ocean views.

highlights.title: Bentota River boat ride
highlights.description: A relaxing boat ride along the Bentota River through mangroves and wildlife.

highlights.title: Tsunami Memorial
highlights.description: Visit the Tsunami Memorial and learn about the 2004 tsunami and its impact on Sri Lanka.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Colombo, the west coast, or an agreed point — and returns you in the evening.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya, Dambulla & Habarana
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup, then a private Cultural Triangle day: climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, visit Dambulla Cave Temple and the Golden Buddha, enjoy a Habarana village safari, and join a Habarana elephant safari at the eco park. Evening return to your hotel.

seo.metaTitle: Sigiriya & Dambulla Day Tour | Lion Rock, Caves & Habarana | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Private Cultural Triangle day: climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, Dambulla Cave Temple and Golden Buddha, Habarana village safari, and elephant safari at the eco park.

highlights.title: Sigiriya Lion Rock
highlights.description: Climb Sigiriya Lion Rock — water gardens, frescoes, and a summit panorama over the Cultural Triangle. Private pace with time for photos and rest. Entrance is paid on site and is not included.

highlights.title: Dambulla Cave Temple & Golden Buddha
highlights.description: Visit Dambulla Cave Temple and the Golden Buddha statue: ancient murals, cave shrines, and the giant seated Buddha above the hillside entrance.

highlights.title: Habarana Village Safari
highlights.description: A Habarana village safari through countryside lanes, rice fields, and local life — a slower look at rural Sri Lanka between the main sites.

highlights.title: Habarana Elephant Safari (Eco Park)
highlights.description: Habarana elephant safari at the eco park — typically Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park depending on the season. Park tickets are extra and not included.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Colombo, the west coast, or an agreed point — and returns you in the evening. Tell us your hotel when you book so we confirm pickup.

title: Kandy Day Tour
shortDescription: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala, Peradeniya Gardens, tea factory, Pinnawala elephants, spice garden, and batik workshop.
description: A private full-day journey into Sri Lanka’s hill capital: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala, Peradeniya Botanical Garden, tea factory, Pinnawala or elephant park, spice garden, and batik workshop.

images.alt: Temple of the Tooth Relic in Kandy on a private day tour
images.title: Kandy Day Tour

itinerary.title: Kandy culture, gardens, tea & elephants
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup, then a private circuit covering Pinnawala or an elephant park, a spice garden, tea plantation and factory, Peradeniya Botanical Garden, Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala Temple, and a batik and saree workshop. Evening return to your hotel.
highlights: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala Temple
Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or elephant park activity
Ceylon Ayurveda herbal and spice garden

images.alt: Temple of the Tooth in Kandy
images.title: Temple of the Tooth in Kandy

optionalActivities: Optional: Nelligala Temple instead of the Temple of the Tooth

seo.metaTitle: Kandy Day Tour | Temple, Gardens, Tea & Pinnawala | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Private Kandy day tour: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala, Peradeniya Botanical Garden, tea factory, Pinnawala elephants, spice garden, and batik workshop.

highlights.title: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala Temple
highlights.description: Visit Kandy’s Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic — one of Sri Lanka’s most important Buddhist sites — or choose Nelligala Temple for a quieter hilltop shrine and wide valley views. Tell us your preference when you book.

highlights.title: Peradeniya Botanical Garden
highlights.description: Stroll the National Botanical Garden at Peradeniya: royal palms, orchid houses, giant fig trees, and riverside lawns. Garden admission is paid on site and is not included.

highlights.title: Tea Plantation & Factory
highlights.description: Walk through a highland tea estate and visit a working factory to see how Ceylon tea is plucked, processed, and tasted.

highlights.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
highlights.description: Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to see rescued elephants at feeding or river time, or choose a nearby elephant park for a guided activity. Park tickets and optional activities are extra.

highlights.title: Ceylon Ayurveda Herbal & Spice Garden
highlights.description: Tour a Ceylon Ayurveda herbal and spice garden: cinnamon, pepper, cocoa, and traditional plant remedies, with a short tasting or demonstration.

highlights.title: Ceylon Batik & Saree Factory
highlights.description: See artisans at a Ceylon batik and saree workshop — wax-resist dyeing, handloom, and finished textiles. Shopping is optional.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Colombo, the west coast, or an agreed point — and returns you in the evening. Tell us your hotel when you book so we confirm pickup.

title: Ella Day Tour — Nine Arch & Elephant Transit Home
shortDescription: A private highland day covering Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Falls, and the Elephant Transit Home.
description: A private full-day journey into Sri Lanka's hill country: Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Ella Falls, and the Elephant Transit Home near Udawalawe, with hotel pickup included.

images.alt: Nine Arch Bridge in Ella on a private day tour
images.title: Ella Day Tour

itinerary.title: Ella highlands & Elephant Transit Home
itinerary.description: Morning pickup, then Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Ella Falls, and the Elephant Transit Home (admission excluded). Return to your hotel in the evening.
highlights: Nine Arch Bridge — walk the viaduct and photo stop
Little Adam’s Peak — gentle hike and summit views
Ravana Ella Falls — roadside waterfall pause
Elephant Transit Home — calf feeding visit near Udawalawe (tickets extra)

images.alt: Nine Arch Bridge rising above tea country in Ella
images.title: Nine Arch Bridge

optionalActivities: Optional: extra time at tea viewpoints or a café stop in Ella town
